rows.grounds: sruc-agra (ladle tip) + param (beyond); locative/ablative compound indicating position beyond the ladle tip in the ritual sequence (L1/L2).
adjective qualifying the nectar; describes the amṛta as causing delight (L1/L2).
sandhi-split compound: patet (may fall) + amṛtam (nectar) + uttamam (supreme); refers to the supreme nectar falling in the rite (L1/L2).
tāvat (then/at that point) + vahnau (in the fire, locative); marks the next step of offering into the fire (L1/L2).
mantra-mukha (mantra at the beginning/mouth); instrumental/locative sense indicating the oblation is made with a mantra (L1/L2).
vauṣaṭ-anta (ending in vauṣaṭ); accusative feminine describing the oblation concluded with the vauṣaṭ exclamation (L1/L2).
accusative singular of huti (offering/oblation); the object to be cast into the fire (L1/L2).
optative 3rd singular of kṣip (to throw/cast); prescribes the ritual action (L1/L2).
